fact: Ethiopia launched the AI UniPod in Addis Ababa, a national AI innovation centre by the Ethiopian AI Institute, Addis Ababa University and UNDP with the Timbuktoo Initiative; no programme or cohort is stated.
source_slug: 2026-02-19 Ethiopia launches AI UniPod to drive innovation

fact: The Ministry of Finance's budget workbook lists an Incubation Center Building Project of ETB 135,679,000 as a capital project of the Artificial Intelligence Institution.
